narrative: On the tables. The pocket tables open on the bed's edge. Three short lines in his hand. A stylus beside them. The grey cloak is on the peg by the door. On the tables. The rest of the leaf is rubbed pale from yesterday. He does not write a sum, a title, or an hour for the moon.
